items.text: inzwa, iwe nyika, mashoko omuromo wangu.
Ko, iyi ndiyo nzira yamunoripira nayo Jehovha here,
Ko, haazi iye Baba wenyu, noMusiki wenyu here,
Nokuti mugove waJehovha ndivo vanhu vake,
kwakanga kusina mwari wokumwe akanga anaye.
Akamuita kuti atasve panzvimbo dzakakwirira dzenyika
uye akamupa zvibereko zveminda kuti adye.
aguta nezvokudya, akava mukobvu uye akava namafuta.
Vakamuita kuti ave negodo nokuda kwavamwari vokumwe
nokuti akanga atsamwiswa navakomana vake navanasikana vake.
"Ndichavanza chiso changu kubva kwavari," iye akadaro,
Vakamutsa godo rangu nokuda kwechinhu chisati chiri Mwari,
vakanditsamwisa nokuda kwezviumbwa zvavo zvisina maturo.
Ndichaita kuti vagodorwe navaya vasati vari vanhu;
idzo dzinopisa kusvikira pasi pegomba rorufu.
Munzira munondo uchaparadza vana vavo vose;
ndigodzima kurangarirwa kwavo kubva pakati pamarudzi,
kuti vavengi vavo vasazozvinzwisisa uye vakazoti,
uye dai vaizonzwisisa izvi nokunzvera kuti magumo avo achazova akaita sei!
Ko, munhu mumwe chete angadzinga sei chiuru chavanhu,
kana kuti vanhu vaviri vangaita kuti vanhu zviuru gumi vatize sei,
kunze kwokunge Jehovha ari iye avaisa mumaoko avo?
Nokuti dombo ravo harina kufanana neDombo redu,
Nokuti mazambiringa avo anobva pamizambiringa yeSodhomu
uye kuparadzwa kwavo kunokurumidza kuuya pamusoro pavo."
uye pasina asara, akatapwa kana asina.
"Chionai zvino kuti ini pachangu ndini Iye!
ndakakuvadza uye ndichaporesa, uye hapana anogona kudzikinura muruoko rwangu.
Ndichaita kuti miseve yangu idhakwe neropa ravo,
Mozisi akauya naJoshua mwanakomana waNuni uye akataura kwaari mashoko ose aya orwiyo urwu vanhu vachinzwa.
Mozisi akati apedza kutaura mashoko ose aya kuvaIsraeri vose,
akati kwavari, "Isai mumwoyo menyu mashoko ose andakupupurirai nhasi, kuitira kuti mugozorayira vana venyu kuti vachenjerere kuita mashoko ose omurayiro uyu.
Haasi mashoko asina maturo kwamuri, asi kuti ndihwo upenyu hwenyu. Namashoko aya muchararama mazuva mazhinji munyika yamuri kuyambuka Jorodhani kuti muitore."
Pazuva rimwe chetero Jehovha akataura kuna Mozisi akati,
"Kwira kumakomo eAbharimu uende mugomo reNebho muMoabhu, riri mhiri kweJeriko, ugoona nyika yeKenani, nyika yandiri kupa vaIsraeri kuti ive yavo.
Ipapo pagomo pauchakwira ndipo pauchafira uye ugova pamwe navanhu vako, sokufa kwakaita mukoma wako Aroni akafira paGomo reHori uye akava navanhu vake.
Izvi zvakaitika nokuti imi muri vaviri hamuna kutendeka kwandiri pamberi pavaIsraeri pamvura yeMeribha Kadheshi murenje reZini uye nokuti hamuna kusimudzira utsvene hwangu pakati pavaIsraeri.
Naizvozvo, uchaona nyika iyi uri chinhambwe; asi haungapindi munyika yandiri kupa kuvanhu veIsraeri."
